summary: Frontend-only test of Clienti background Excel export flow. Login admin/admin123 → Clienti tab → clicked 'Esporta Excel'. Verified full background flow: POST /api/clienti/export/excel/start returned 200 {job_id, status:'processing'}; poll GET /status/{job_id} returned status='ready' with size=38771; GET /download/{job_id} returned 200 with Content-Type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet and Content-Length 38771. Success toast 'Excel pronto - File scaricato: clienti_export_2026-09-09.xlsx' displayed. Export button returned to normal (no 'Esportando' state remaining). No error toasts. Feature works end-to-end as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: ClientiManagement.jsx is 1862 lines — consider splitting into smaller focused modules for maintainability.
Excessive console.log noise on every render ('getAvailableCommesse DEBUG', 'RENDER DEBUG') — should be gated behind a debug flag or removed for production.
handleExportExcel polling uses setTimeout recursion without a cancellation mechanism on component unmount — could set state on unmounted component if user navigates away mid-export.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clienti background Excel export UI flow fully verified via network interception. Job start → status ready → xlsx blob download → 'Excel pronto' toast all working. First toast 'Esportazione avviata' fires from code (line 795-798) but was replaced quickly by the 'Excel pronto' toast because job completed within ~1.5s poll cycle; this is expected behavior for small datasets (44 clienti).
